security_finding.vulnerability_type: OWASP Top 10 API1:2023 - Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
security_finding.exploit_mechanism: By modifying the 'account_id' URL parameter in Charles Proxy from 98711 to 98712, the server returned full profile data of a different user without re-authenticating the bearer token.
security_finding.remediation_strategy: Implement strict server-side access control validation ensuring the authenticated context matches the requested resource entity ID.
